description: Delete a wiki page: it goes to its space's TRASH and waits there 30 days before it is deleted for good — 'inTrashUntil' says when. Until then the project's administrators can bring it back with restore_wiki_page (list_wiki_trash lists the trash). Identify it by 'id', or by 'spaceKey' + 'title'. A page with pages beneath it is never deleted with them silently: without a word on them the answer is deleted: false with 'descendants' (how many), 'children' (the ones you can read) and 'hidden'. Then either pass rehang: true — its children move up to its parent, in its place and order, and the page alone goes to the trash — or cascade: true (includeChildren: true is the same) to send the whole subtree to the trash with it. The space home page can never be deleted. Requires permission to edit the wiki.

cascade.description: Send the page's descendants to the trash along with it. Off by default.

includeChildren.description: Send the page's descendants to the trash along with it. Off by default. The same as cascade.

rehang.description: Move the page's children up to its parent (or the top of the space), keeping their order, and delete the page alone. Off by default.

spaceKey.description: Space key, when identifying the page by title.

title.description: Exact page title, when identifying the page by title.

name: delete_wiki_page
